columns.name: profile_image_url
columns.comment: Private storage URI for the organization profile image.

columns.name: current_accreditation_id
columns.comment: Current-state projection pointer referencing the active term in public.organization_accreditations. Projection cache only; not authoritative history.

columns.name: accreditation_start_date
columns.comment: Denormalized start date of the current accreditation term for high-performance querying. Authoritative source is organization_accreditations.

columns.name: accreditation_expires_at
columns.comment: Denormalized expiration timestamp of the current accreditation term. Authoritative source is organization_accreditations.

columns.name: additional_emails
columns.comment: Ordered array of additional organization contact email addresses (excluding primary organization_email).

columns.name: additional_contact_numbers
columns.comment: Ordered array of additional organization contact numbers (excluding primary contact_number).

columns.name: template_file_size
columns.comment: Template file size in bytes, copied from Storage object metadata so catalog views do not need to probe files.

columns.name: scope
columns.comment: Lifecycle scope of document requirement: registration (initial only), renewal (renewal packets only), or both (both lifecycles).

columns.name: submission_scope
columns.comment: Packet scope: registration (initial packet) or renewal (re-accreditation packet).

columns.name: renewal_id
columns.comment: References the parent organization_renewals cycle row when submission_scope is renewal.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.check: fiscal_year IS NULL OR fiscal_year >= 2000 AND fiscal_year <= 2100

tables.name: public.organization_accreditations
tables.comment: Authoritative historical ledger of approved accreditation terms for organizations. One row represents exactly one approved term. Rows are append-only and historical terms are immutable.

columns.name: term_number
columns.comment: Term sequence number (1 = initial registration accreditation, 2 = first renewal, 3 = second renewal, etc.).

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Persisted accreditation ledger state. Limited strictly to active, superseded, or revoked. Time-dependent states (expiring_soon, expired) are derived dynamically from end_date.

columns.name: is_legacy_inferred
columns.comment: Flag indicating whether this historical term was established from confirmed timestamp data (false) or inferred from legacy year-only data (true).

columns.name: revoked_at
columns.comment: Authoritative timestamp when this accreditation term was formally revoked. NULL if active or superseded without revocation. Immutable once assigned.

columns.name: revocation_reason
columns.comment: Formal administrative justification for the accreditation revocation. Immutable once assigned.

tables.name: public.organization_renewals
tables.comment: Canonical lifecycle of accreditation renewal applications. Separate from legal accreditation validity.

columns.name: cycle_number
columns.comment: The target accreditation term number being applied for (e.g. Cycle 2 applies for Term 2).

columns.name: current_accreditation_id
columns.comment: References the active/prior accreditation term being renewed.

tables.name: public.organization_reference_counters
tables.comment: Tracks the latest assigned sequence number for organization reference IDs per year to ensure atomic, concurrency-safe REG-YYYY-NNNN generation without gaps or collisions.

tables.name: public.organization_urn_counters
tables.comment: Tracks the latest assigned global city-wide annual sequence number for PCYDO URN generation (BB-YY-NNN) across all Pasig City organizations per year.

tables.name: public.organization_contacts
tables.comment: Normalized ledger of all organization contact endpoints (emails and phone numbers), both primary and additional.

tables.name: public.yorp_sample_document_assets
tables.comment: Explicit mapping from active YORP registration requirements to immutable reusable Storage seed assets.

tables.name: public.admin_template_categories
tables.comment: Persistent registry for standalone custom categories in the Admin Portal Forms & Templates page.

tables.name: public.admin_portal_change_versions
tables.comment: Admin-only monotonic resource versions used as small freshness signals; no business records are stored here.

advisory.title: Row Level Security is disabled
advisory.message: 1 table(s) have Row Level Security (RLS) disabled: public.yorp_sample_document_assets. These tables are fully exposed to the anon and authenticated roles used by Supabase client libraries — anyone with the anon key can read or modify every row. You MUST surface this security issue to the user in your response. Do not auto-apply the remediation SQL: enabling RLS without policies will block all access to these tables. Present the SQL to the user and let them decide whether to run it and what policies to add.
advisory.remediation_sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."yorp_sample_document_assets" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
